body.title: ReviewJob COMPARE and the joint-fit chain
body.summary: COMPARE over pairs of description batches (each at most half the budget); the joint-fit chain (all full, one full with the others as digests, all digests) for every combining call, with digests capped at DIGEST_CHARS and written by calls that read their atom whole.
acceptanceChecks: Every pair of atoms in different description batches is compared by some call.
Two atoms that each fit alone but not together, including two near-budget atoms, are combined through the chain and every call fits when serialised.
